# U145: The metric chosen survives Check: as Rhea, a goal measured by Pipeline queue wait (p90) for CI/CD; a reload on Check still reads “Pipeline queue wait (p90), for CI/CD.”; “Change” on Who and where puts focus on its first field, and choosing Build & Release then Continue reads “for Build & Release.”; Publish saves the goal measured by it for Build & Release

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRICS-MEASURED-BY`, `NEW-GOAL-STEPS`
- **Budget:** at most 24 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U145

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Check:** “What do you want to achieve?” is shown.
- **Step.** Type “Queue wait kept short” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Team” button in the “Level” group.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Press the “Measured by” button in the Measured by line.
- **Step.** Type “queue” into a search field in the open find-and-pick list.
- **Step.** Press the “Pipeline queue wait (p90)” option in the open find-and-pick list.
- **Check:** “min, whole numbers, lower is better: from the metric.” is shown in the Measured by line (else: choosing a metric does not say what it fills in).
- **Step.** Type “9” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “4” into the “Target” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- _Note:_ A reload on Check (or coming back to the kept draft) reads the choice from the draft.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “Pipeline queue wait (p90), for CI/CD.” is shown in the “Read back” list (else: after a reload, Check has lost the metric).
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if after a reload, Measured by reads “{measured()}”.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Publish goal” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if after a reload, Check says “No metric”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “reloaded”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Change on Who and where: focus on the step's first field, then another team; Continue comes straight back.
- **Step.** Press the “Change who and where” button in the “Read back” list.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) it fails if after Change on Who and where, focus is left on the page, not the step’s first field.
- Find and pick: press “Team”, type “Build”, and choose “Build & Release”.
- If the “Keep it in Build & Release” button is there:
  - **Step.** Press the “Keep it in Build & Release” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “Pipeline queue wait (p90), for Build & Release.” is shown in the “Read back” list (else: after a new team, the metric is still for the old one).
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if after a new team, Measured by reads “{measured()}”.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the note bad (`.note-bad`) is not there (else: Check says something still needs fixing).
- **Step.** Press the “Publish goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…?…published=1” in the demo.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the published goal is measured by {worked out in the journey as `link ? '${link.metricId} for ${link.teamId}' : 'nothing'`} (team {made && made.teamId}).
- Close this browser.
